name: OpenCart
title: opencart.com
shortDescription: OpenCart is an open-source eCommerce platform designed to help businesses of all sizes create and manage their online store. It offers a range of customizable modules and themes, allowing users to tailor their sites to meet specific needs. The platform supports various payment gateways and shipping methods, making it ideal for businesses looking to expand globally. OpenCart is particularly beneficial for small to medium-sized enterprises looking to launch their eCommerce operations without significant upfront investment.
pros: Open source with zero monthly fees
Extensive selection of modules and themes
Supports multiple payment and shipping methods
cons: May require technical knowledge to customize
Limited scalability compared to some paid solutions
Community support can vary in quality
